text.lead: A Beautiful Life is a 2023 Danish drama romance music film directed by Mehdi Avaz and starring Christopher Lund Nissen. It was released on 1 June 2023 by Netflix.
text.plot: Elliott is a young Danish fisherman who lost his family in an accident and was orphaned as a child. With little money in his pocket, his luck is an extraordinary voice. One night, while performing at a club to do his friend Oliver a favor, he is noticed by the successful music manager, Suzanne. Soon, Suzanne pairs Elliott with her estranged daughter and music producer, Lilly. Elliott accepts their help and tries to write and record a song. Success comes quickly, almost overwhelmingly. On his way to becoming a star, the young man must deal with unexpected popularity, growing feelings for Lilly, and unresolved issues from the past.
